items.watch: Andy Reid's Monday update on the hamstring; Kansas City is off in Week 5
items.text: Rashee Rice (KC) hurt his hamstring in the first quarter @LV, pulling up after a 7-yard catch, and the Chiefs called him doubtful to return. Kansas City has its bye in Week 5, so he has two weeks before the next game. WR17 rest of season for me; monitor Andy Reid's Monday update.

Ladd McConkey (LAC) played @SEA through the foot, aggravated it in the first half and was ruled out for the rest of the game with no catches on 2 targets. He did not practice Thursday this week. WR23 rest of season for me; monitor Wednesday's practice report.

Jalen Coker (CAR) is inactive vs DET tonight with the quad, as the Saturday elevation of Ja'Seem Reed pointed to. Darren Waller, with a team-high 8 targets in Week 3 on a 51 percent snap share, is TE18 for me, a streamer tonight.

Lamar Jackson (BAL) hurt his ankle on a sack on the last play of the first half vs TEN and did not return, after completing 15 of 20 for 222 yards and two touchdowns. Jesse Minter called him day-to-day after the 24-18 win, and Tyler Huntley finished the game; leave Huntley on the wire until Jackson's status is known. Jackson is QB2 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.

Saquon Barkley (PHI) hurt his right hamstring on a 6-yard run in the first quarter vs LAR and was ruled out before halftime, with 2 carries for 8 yards. He walked out of the stadium normally after the 24-20 loss, per NBC Sports Philadelphia. RB8 rest of season for me; hold him. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.

Tank Bigsby (PHI) took 14 carries for 55 yards after Saquon Barkley left, to Will Shipley's 6 for 23, then needed help off the field late in the fourth quarter. Bigsby is RB55 rest of season for me and the back to own if Barkley misses time; Shipley stays on the wire. Claim Bigsby, 5 to 10 percent of FAAB.

items.watch: the concussion protocol and Wednesday's practice report
items.text: Ja'Marr Chase (CIN) left the 22-17 loss to JAX in the second quarter with a concussion after a facemask tackle, with 3 catches for 27 yards. Joe Burrow still threw 54 times for 428 yards, and Tee Higgins caught 11 for 157; hold Higgins, WR16 rest of season for me. Chase is WR1 rest of season. Monitor; the concussion protocol and Wednesday's practice report.

DJ Moore (BUF) left the 29-26 loss to NE late in the second quarter with the same shoulder that knocked him out of the Week 2 game and limited him in practice all week. He is WR24 rest of season for me. Khalil Shakir is WR53 rest of season; leave him where he is. Monitor Moore; Wednesday's practice report.

Mack Hollins (NE) left the 29-26 win at BUF early in the third quarter with a non-contact calf injury after catching 3 of 4 targets for 53 yards. He led New England with 16 targets through three games. Efton Chism caught the winning 23-yard touchdown, but he had two catches all season before Sunday; leave Chism on the wire. Monitor Hollins; Wednesday's practice report.

items.why: A rib setback that keeps him out of Wednesday's practice would change the call.
items.text: Mike Evans (SF) is active vs DEN after a week of side work with the ribs, and Ladd McConkey (LAC) is active @SEA with the foot. Evans is WR25 rest of season for me; hold him through the ribs. McConkey stays WR39 for me this week, a low-end flex play to a dart throw.
Zay Flowers (BAL) is active vs TEN after the questionable tag, and left tackle Ronnie Stanley (toe) is active too. Flowers caught 5 of 6 for 84 on 21 snaps in Week 3. WR9 for me this week.

Kenyon Sadiq (NYJ) is active @CHI after a week of limited practices with the back, and Mason Taylor, Adonai Mitchell and Breece Hall are inactive. Sadiq ran 58 percent of the routes at DET with Taylor out. TE14 for me, a borderline start this week.

Washington made Terry McLaurin (WAS) inactive in London vs IND with the hamstring he hurt in Friday's practice, along with Rachaad White. Stefon Diggs (WAS) is WR27 for me, a high-end WR3. Pivot to Diggs.

Ladd McConkey (LAC) is expected to play @SEA despite the questionable tag, per NFL Network's Ian Rapoport, after a limited Friday with the foot. He played 88 percent of the snaps in Week 3. WR39 for me, a low-end flex play to a dart throw. Monitor; LAC inactives at 2:55 PM ET.

Tyjae Spears (TEN) is active @BAL with the ankle, so the Titans keep the split. Tony Pollard (TEN) played 53 percent of the snaps with 80 percent of the early downs; RB29 for me, a high-end RB3 and a flex play.

Carolina put Xavier Legette (CAR) on injured reserve Saturday with the knee he hurt in Week 2, so he misses at least four games and is not back before Nov 8 vs DEN. He has not played since Week 2 and is WR106 rest of season for me. Drop him for any add on the list.

Carolina elevated receiver Ja'Seem Reed from the practice squad Saturday, the move Dave Canales said would come if Jalen Coker (CAR) could not play with the quad. Coker is outside my top 50 receivers either way; Darren Waller, with a team-high 8 targets in Week 3, is TE18 for me vs DET, a streamer Sunday night.

Kyle Shanahan calls Mike Evans (SF) a game-time decision with the ribs after side work only Friday, and Evans says he will try to play in a padded shirt. Monitor; SF inactives Sunday at 2:55 PM ET for the 4:25 PM ET kickoff vs DEN.
items.watch: SF inactives Sunday at 2:55 PM ET

items.text: The Colts ruled out Keenan Allen (IND) for London vs WAS with the groin after a Friday DNP and elevated Nick Westbrook-Ikhine from the practice squad. Pierce is on IR too, so Josh Downs and Tyler Warren are the targets. Pivot to Wan'Dale Robinson (WR38).
Josh Downs (IND) has seen 3, 9 and 11 targets since Alec Pierce went down, and Keenan Allen is ruled out for London. WR15 for me this week @WAS, a WR2.

Keaton Mitchell (LAC) played 38 percent of the snaps in Week 3 with 8 carries for 52, and he is at 5.0 a carry on the season, while Omarion Hampton's snap share has gone 58, 63 and 42 percent. RB46 rest of season for me. Stash Mitchell, 2 to 4 percent of FAAB.

Mike Washington Jr. (LV) has 15 carries for 102, and his head coach said on Sep 11 and again on Sep 28 that he earned more work. Ashton Jeanty still has 63 of the two backs' 78 carries and 16 targets and is RB9 for me vs KC. Washington is RB43 rest of season for me. Stash him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.

Houston's backfield is closer to even than Week 3 said: the snaps were about level in Week 1, 42 to 38 in Week 2 and 34 to 20 in Week 3, and Woody Marks has 8 targets to David Montgomery's (HOU) 7. Montgomery is at 2.8 a carry. RB22 for me this week vs DAL, an RB2; Marks is RB33, a low-end RB3.

Brian Thomas Jr. (JAX) was on the field for 23 of 62 snaps vs NE, 13 to 15 routes, and comes off it in two-tight-end sets. He is outside my top 50 receivers this week @CIN; sit him. WR40 rest of season for me.
Isaiah Likely (NYG) has gone 49, 69 and 84 percent of the snaps, with 22 routes on 27 dropbacks in Week 3. TE9 for me this week vs ARI.
Jake Ferguson (DAL) has 11 targets on 105 throws, and his snap share has gone 76, 60 and 69 percent while Brevyn Spann-Ford climbed to 38. TE20 for me @HOU, outside my top 12; sit him.

Jakobi Meyers (JAX) was limited Wednesday and Thursday with the thumb he has played through all season and has no designation for Sunday @CIN. He caught 7 for 64 and a touchdown vs NE on 81 percent of the snaps. WR31 for me, a low-end WR3, a low-end flex play.

Zay Flowers (BAL) is questionable vs TEN after the Ravens listed him limited Friday with rest beside the hamstring, a day after a full practice. He played 21 snaps in Week 3 and caught 5 of 6 for 84. WR9 for me this week; have a 1 PM receiver ready until the 11:30 AM ET inactives.

Seattle ruled Jadarian Price (SEA) out vs LAC Friday with the chest injury he reinjured Wednesday. Zach Charbonnet is Week 5 at the earliest, so Emanuel Wilson and George Holani split the backfield; Wilson ran for 92 yards on 21 carries in Week 2 when Price left. Wilson is RB31 for me, a low-end RB3. Pivot to Wilson.

Nico Collins (HOU) practiced in full Friday after limited sessions Wednesday and Thursday and has no designation for DAL, his first game back from the hamstring. WR13 for me, borderline WR1/WR2 this week.
DJ Moore (BUF) was limited all week with the shoulder but has no designation for NE. He led Buffalo with 10 targets on 64 percent of the snaps last week. WR23 for me this week, a WR2.

Minnesota ruled Justin Jefferson (MIN) out vs MIA Friday after he missed every practice with the ankle sprain; Kevin O'Connell still calls him day to day. Jordan Addison drew 9 of Kyler Murray's 29 throws at TB and is WR25 for me this week, a high-end WR3. Pivot to Addison.

Philadelphia ruled DeVonta Smith (PHI) out vs LAR after three missed practices with the hamstring, and league sources expect him to miss two to three games. Dontayvion Wicks ran 81 percent of the routes at CHI and is WR40 for me, a low-end flex play to a dart throw. Pivot to Wicks in deep leagues.
Dallas Goedert (PHI) is ruled out vs LAR with the sprained MCL, along with Hollywood Brown, so Mundt and Ertz split the tight end snaps. Juwan Johnson is TE8 for me this week. Pivot to Johnson.

Jaylen Wright (MIA) practiced in full Thursday, is expected to play at MIN and is listed first on the depth chart, with the staff signaling a shared workload. Ollie Gordon II played 82 percent of the snaps vs KC with Wright out. Gordon is RB35 for me, a low-end RB3; sit him.

Jaylen Wright (MIA) is back at full practice and listed as Miami's RB1 for Sunday at MIN, ahead of Ollie Gordon II, in a split the staff has already signaled. Stash him, 5 to 10 percent of FAAB, until the first-quarter carries show the lead role.
Ladd McConkey (LAC) did not practice Thursday after a limited Wednesday with the foot and is questionable @SEA. He is WR24 for me if active, a WR2. Monitor Sunday's inactives and have a backup ready.
Bucky Irving (TB) practiced in full Friday after two limited days with the glute and has no designation. RB19 for me this week vs GB, an RB2.
Puka Nacua (LAR) has no designation for Sunday @PHI, though Sean McVay said his snaps may be limited in his first game since Week 1. WR13 for me, borderline WR1/WR2 this week.
Nico Collins (HOU) practiced Friday after limited sessions Wednesday and Thursday with the hamstring. WR11 for me, borderline WR1/WR2 this week vs DAL.

Kenyon Sadiq (NYJ) is questionable @CHI with the back after limited practices Wednesday and Thursday, and Mason Taylor and Adonai Mitchell are out. He ran 58 percent of the routes at DET. TE13 for me, a borderline start this week if he is active.

Jalen Coker (CAR) is questionable with the quad after limited practices Thursday and Friday. Darren Waller's snap share has gone 35, 44 and 51 percent with a team-high 8 targets in Week 3. Waller is TE18 for me; monitor Carolina's inactives Sunday night and stream him vs DET if Coker sits.

Terrance Ferguson (LAR) is ruled out with the ankle and Colby Parkinson is questionable, not out. Tyler Higbee caught 8 of 11 targets at DEN once Ferguson got hurt. Stream Higbee @PHI and check Parkinson's status at Sunday's inactives.
Jadarian Price (SEA) was limited Wednesday and did not practice Thursday with a chest injury, after 6 touches on 19 snaps at WAS. RB31 for me by rank, a high-end RB3, but sit him.

Tony Pollard (TEN) has no designation for Sunday at BAL and Tyjae Spears (ankle) is questionable. Pollard played 53 percent of the snaps with 80 percent of the early downs. RB29 for me, a high-end RB3, a high-end flex play.
D'Andre Swift (CHI) missed Thursday with the knee, practiced in full Friday and has no designation; Kyle Monangai stays the change of pace. Swift is RB17 for me this week vs NYJ, an RB2.

Washington ruled Rachaad White (WAS) out for London after he missed every practice with the shoulder. Jacory Croskey-Merritt played 57 percent of the snaps with 19 carries vs SEA, with Austin Ekeler on passing downs. Croskey-Merritt is RB24 for me this week, an RB2.

Carnell Tate (TEN) ran a route on 92 percent of the dropbacks and drew 9 targets, 26 percent, vs NYG, the full-time role next to Wan'Dale Robinson. WR34 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a bench WR.

Denzel Boston (CLE) played 95 percent of the snaps and ran 92 percent of the routes vs PIT, 4 for 89 on 7 targets, and has 52 percent of Cleveland's air yards this season. WR46 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a bench WR.

Roman Wilson (PIT) scored on 3 catches for 74 at CLE, but he played 30 percent of the snaps and ran 40 percent of the routes. WR104 rest of season for me; do not chase the touchdown. Monitor his route share in Week 5.

Dan Quinn ruled Jayden Daniels (WAS) out Friday for the London game vs IND; the dislocated left elbow gets a full week of practice before Washington decides on Week 5. Marcus Mariota makes his second straight start after every snap and 3 touchdowns vs SEA. Mariota is QB17 for me, a streamer, and Daniels managers pivot to him or any QB in my top 18.

Aaron Glenn ruled Breece Hall (NYJ) out Friday with the quad, along with Adonai Mitchell (finger). Braelon Allen played every snap after Hall left at DET, and Isaiah Davis has no offensive snap this season. Allen is RB20 for me this week, an RB2 @CHI.

New Orleans put Travis Etienne Jr. (NO) on IR Thursday with the hamstring, so he is out at least four games and Week 8 is the earliest return. After Etienne left in Week 3, Alvin Kamara took 6 of the next 10 carries and 20 of 34 second-half snaps, with Kendre Miller next and CJ Donaldson on short yardage. Kamara is RB25 for me vs ATL, a high-end RB3, a high-end flex play.

Lamar Jackson (BAL) practiced in full Thursday after a limited Wednesday with the back, and Jesse Minter called it something small. Both centers are still out, so a rookie guard snaps to him. The Menu flag comes off; he stays QB2 for me vs TEN.

Mike Evans (SF) missed Thursday's practice too and worked on the side with the ribs; general manager John Lynch said he will make every attempt to play vs DEN. He left the ARI game in the second quarter after the hit and is not ranked on the Menu until he practices. Monitor; Friday's practice line and designation.

DJ Moore (BUF) was limited Wednesday and Thursday with the shoulder, the same as last week, when he played and drew a team-high 10 targets, 6 for 67, on 64 percent of the snaps vs LAC. The Menu rows keep the flag. WR23 for me this week, a WR2 vs NE.

Zay Flowers (BAL) practiced in full Thursday after a limited Wednesday with the hamstring, so the 21-snap pitch count from Brazil should lift. On 26 routes this season he has 234 yards and a target on 48 percent of them. The flag comes off; WR9 for me vs TEN.

items.price: a flex-level receiver, or a bench back with a clearer path
items.text: Seattle opened Zach Charbonnet's 21-day practice window Thursday; he must sit the first four games, so Week 5 is the earliest he plays, and he takes the short-yardage, goal-line and pass-protection snaps when active. Jadarian Price (SEA) had 6 touches on 19 snaps at WAS, third of the three backs, with 2 lost fumbles on 32 touches. RB31 for me, a high-end RB3 by rank and a sit vs LAC. Trade him away now; ask for a flex-level receiver.

Christian Watson (GB) was not on Wednesday's injury report and was not mentioned Thursday, so the hamstring listing after Week 3 did not carry into Week 4. He has 24 percent of the targets, 80 percent of the routes and a touchdown in every game, and Jayden Reed is on IR. WR10 for me this week at TB.
